description: A toy kitchen set is in front, with a tall gray refrigerator on the left and a countertop with a yellow cup and a pink bowl on the right. The left hand pulls the refrigerator door open, then lifts the pink bowl and uses both hands briefly to collect small cube pieces; the right hand drops the cubes into the dispenser bin on the inside of the fridge door while the left hand steadies the bowl, then the left hand sets the bowl back on the counter and swings the fridge door closed.
